question: Who among the following sportspersons is credited with the autobiography ‘Undisputed Truth’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mike Tyson.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The Autobiography of Mike Tyson is **Undisputed Truth: My Autobiography**.
